player_prompt.intro:
Jumaxa Player {player_id} sas. Jumaxa Memory Game sas utjana.
Q'umaxa, p'iqi ch'alla t'aqa t'aqanaka k'umara, ukatxa qhana ch'alla t'aqa t'aqanakaxa.
Kunawsa, p'iqi t'aqa t'aqanakaru t'arwa t'arwaniwa, ukatxa qhana t'aqa t'aqanakaru t'arwa t'arwaniwa, '[0 1 1 0]' ukjam sas, nayra t'aqa t'aqanakaxa 0 t'arwani ukatxa 1 t'arwani, ukatxa qhana t'aqa t'aqanakaxa 1 t'arwani ukatxa 0 t'arwani.
Jichha t'aqa t'aqanakaxa, jumaxaxa puntuwa, ukatxa t'aqa t'aqanakaxa janq'u k'umara. Jichha jan ukjam, t'aqa t'aqanakaxa janq'u k'umaraki, '.
Kunawsa, t'aqa t'aqanakaxa tukuyanakaxa.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Jani wali wakichata. {player_id} anatirixa janiw mä chiqpach amtaru jayskiti, paréntesis cuadrados ukankiwa.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Jan wali amta. {player_id} anatirix anqaxankiri chiqaruw ajlliwiyi.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Jani waliki. {player_id} anatirixa pay kutiw mä carta ajlliwiyi.
invalid_move.already_matched: Jani waliki. {player_id} anatirixa maya jani ukaxa paypacha khariñwa ajlliwayxi, ukata mayakiptayatawa.

game_message.cards_no_match: Player {player_id} t'aqa t'aqanakaxa jan ukjam tukuyanakaxa. T'aqa t'aqanakaxa [{r1} {c1}] ukatxa [{r2} {c2}] {pos1} ukatxa {pos2} t'arwani.

outcome.turn_limit: Nayrïr kutiw mä juk'a pachanak anatasiñatak wakt'ayata. Anatt ' añasti tukusxiwa, 0 anatañanix {score_0} puntos jikxatawayi; 1 anatañaninakax {score_1} puntos jikxatapxaraki.
